character: 50 km family-friendly domain. Quiet, uncrowded, good for beginners.
name: La Norma
description: 45km of pistes, 12 lifts, linked with Valfréjus to create a 65km combined area. Purpose-built but low-rise village at 1,350m, built around the old hamlet of Le Charmaix. Known for: uncrowded slopes, excellent value, and being a 'freerider's gem' — Powderhounds rated it for superb off-piste with easy exit onto groomed trails. 5 min from Modane TGV station (Paris-Lyon-Turin line).

lift_pass_pricing.note: One of the cheapest in the Alps.

suitability.value: Excellent — one of the cheapest domains in the Alps
